_doc: Budgets the install matrix enforces (scripts/ci/check_budgets.py). The limits are the user's budgets (upper limits; lower is better): agent start to ready < 30 s, desktop launch to ready < 60 s, install < 180 s; plus the 20 s shutdown budget. A step without a budget stays report-only. Seconds are wall-clock on GitHub-hosted runners. See docs/design/install-and-startup-implementation.md (A0, A4, R7).
